name: Door sills, the Dalí footpath kerb and the south Dalí arch approach
about: Small level changes the player steps over (issue #57). Each is a ground-height offset over the lie of the land, not a terrain change: sills and the kerbed footpath are 0.12 m, the arch approach rises 0.25 m over 5 m. House floors are untouched. Heights from data/levels_survey.json (elena-south-sills, dali-footpath-kerb, dali-south-approach), built to the middle of each range.
trust: Photo-supported: which doors have sills and their red treads, the kerbed lawn strip and tiled footpath along the Dalí frontage with a slot drain at the arched porch, and the flagstone approach with flared white kerbs and a grooved foot strip. Estimated: every height (read by eye, not measured), sill sizes, door positions to about 1 m, the frontage stations to about 2 m, and the approach length and kerb flare to about 1 m. Not modelled: the white patio wall and the doors themselves west of the Elena lawns, and the covered passage behind the Dalí arch (the registry building stays solid).

sills.name: Elena south · sill at the door at the end of the lawn path
sills.trust: Red tread with a white riser where the tiled path between the two lawns meets a brown door in the white wall on their west side. Door placed just past the traced end of cervantes-lawn-door-path, facing back along it; IMG_2330 puts it at bearing 182 deg against 184 deg here. Height 0.12 m and size estimated.
sills.bearingNote: Bearing of the door from the camera, from its compass heading plus the door's pixel offset (about 1162 px focal length). IMG_2261's heading reads about 20 deg low against both doors; only the spacing between them is used from it.

sills.name: Elena south · sill at the second door, north along the same wall
sills.trust: Red sill under a brown door set in a slightly projecting length of the same wall, about 2.8 m north of the first, with shrubs in front (IMG_2261). IMG_2330 puts it at bearing 195 deg against 190 deg here. Spacing, projection and height estimated.
sills.bearingNote: Bearing of the door from the camera, from its compass heading plus the door's pixel offset (about 1162 px focal length). IMG_2261's heading reads about 20 deg low against both doors; only the spacing between them is used from it.

omittedDoors.door: brown door under an arched hood on the east side of Elena south, at the junction
omittedDoors.why: The door is in the photo but its foot is hidden by planting, so no sill is visible, and the pin (±2.1 m) cannot place it along the frontage to better than about 2 m. Left out.

footpathKerb.name: Pintor Dalí · kerbed lawn strip and footpath between Eva and Patricia

drain.name: Slot drain at the arched porch threshold

footpathKerb.trust: IMG_2291 and IMG_2292 show the house-side tiled footpath and a grass strip standing a white kerb above the asphalt, and the porch floor under the arch flush with the path behind a slot drain. IMG_2292 shows the lawn strip ending with the kerb turned in to the path's own edge; past it cars nose up to the path, as on the left of IMG_2293, whose right-hand kerb runs along the lane like the south end here. The kerb follows the Dalí car park's house-side edge in data/dali_cervantes.json from the building corner by Eva to the corner where the bays start; the footprint runs on into the registry building, which hides it. The lawn-strip end (±3 m), the arch position (±2 m) and 0.12 m are estimates. The 2.5 m north of the building corner is not photographed: the rise fades out there instead of adding a kerb. The map puts Calle Patricia about 3.7 m further south than the end of the band, across the bay tip, so the apron is not carried on into the lane.

approach.name: Pintor Dalí south · flagstone approach to the arch
approach.trust: Flagstones between rounded white kerbs rise gently, with no step, from a grooved concrete strip at the asphalt to the arched passage (IMG_2283, corroborated by IMG_2294/2295). The arch is put at the back of the recess in registry building 6263501UF1366S_part1; the axis is square to that face and passes within 0.8 m of the IMG_2283 camera, whose heading (60 deg) matches the 58 deg here. The left kerb runs straight and the right one kinks outward towards the parking, as photographed; the foot ends at the edge of the bays beside it. Rise 0.25 m over 5 m (survey 0.15-0.35 m over 5-6 m) and kerbs 0.18 m above the asphalt are by eye. The passage through the building is not opened.
